features into any application, whether you&#x27;re creating voice agents, real-time transcription tools, accessibility solutions, podcasts, or interactive audio experiences.</p><h2 id="speech-to-text"><a class="heading-anchor" href="#speech-to-text">Speech to Text</a></h2><figure class="not-prose mx-auto my-6 max-w-[1100px] lg:my-12"><div class="bg-card overflow-hidden
